thread: jamie: dropped a new frame for the Version Timeline compact cluster behavior. aim: reduce vertical noise and make rollback discoverable without making it too easy to misclick. figma: https://figma.redwood/timeline/cluster-compact kiran: looked good. question: when clusters collapse, how do we indicate there are multiple minor releases inside? the mock shows a +3 badge but it's small. maria: prefer a stacked indicator with count and brief shimmer on hover: '3 releases' tooltip that expands to condensed list on hover/focus. keeps density but surfaces detail on demand. taylor: hover-only interactions are bad for keyboard/sr users. we should implement focus to expand and also a persistent "peek" affordance for touch. maybe a chevron button that toggles the condensed list and is reachable via keyboard. nina: agree. add aria-controls and aria-expanded to the chevron button, and an sr-only label like 'Toggle releases inside cluster'. For the tooltip, use role="status" with polite live updates when expanded. sam: dev feasibility: toggling on focus is ok, but we need to avoid rendering huge diffs inline. condensed list should be 1-line per version with 'View diff' linking to modal. jamie: noted. copy for the condensed rows: short pattern: 'v2.3.1 — 5 files changed — deployed by @kiran — 2h ago'. keep it single line. any objections? kiran: that's fine. microcopy nit: use em-dash vs hyphen for readability? figma probably handles it but let's standardize to '—'. maria: yes use em-dash. also add a subtle status pill 'stable' or 'canary 5%' after the version name where applicable. color contrast check needed. taylor: accessibility on pills: do not rely on color only. include text labels and, for small pills, add an icon and sr-only explanatory text. e.g., '🟢Stable'. nina: keyboard shortcuts request: could we add J/K to move between versions and R to trigger rollback shortcut (with confirm)? If we add shortcuts, we must document them in an accessible help panel and allow disabling. Also ensure focus stays correct after commands. jamie: Ooh. I like J/K navigation. But R triggering rollback is scary. we can reserve uppercase R with modifier (Shift+R) and require type-to-confirm for production. Also explicit visual toast and focus trap on the confirm dialog. kiran: engineering note: keyboard shortcuts are doable but require global key handling and per-route scoping. we'll create a shortcuts registry. confirm modal should trap focus and be cancellable with Esc. maria: copy options for the rollback shortcut confirm modal header: 'Confirm rollback' vs 'Confirm rollback to selected version' — which is clearer? taylor: 'Confirm rollback to selected version' is explicit. body copy: 'This will restore traffic to vX.Y.Z. This action is reversible only by redeploying. Type "ROLLBACK" to proceed.' keep the sentence about reversibility accurate — it's reversible by redeploying, but avoid implying automatic undo. nina: suggest adding role="alertdialog" for the confirm modal when it's destructive, set aria-describedby to the explanatory text, and focus the input for type-to-confirm on open. keyboard: Enter submits when the typed value matches. sam: front-end caution: type-to-confirm needs to debounce and avoid storing the typed value anywhere persistent. add tests to ensure clipboard autofill doesn't bypass check. jamie: good catch. UI placement question: should the rollback CTA live inline on each version row, or be in the expanded panel for the version? Inline is faster but riskier. I'm leaning expanded panel + shortcut for power users. kiran: expanded panel makes sense. but surface a small 'Quick rollback' icon only for non-prod environments? maybe show inline for staging and hide for prod. maria: alternatively show inline but disabled in prod with tooltip 'Rollback requires confirmation' — visually hinting at risk. user still has to open confirm modal. taylor: whichever we choose, ensure disabled state conveys why — not just ghosted. aria-describedby on disabled button can link to explanation. nina: contrast on timeline timestamps: small gray text at 12px is failing AA. bump to 13-14px or darken to meet 4.5:1. Also ensure focus ring is visible on version rows when using keyboard nav. jamie: i'll update the token palette. another UX idea: show a transient timeline scrubber when dragging the timeline to preview what percentage of traffic each version had historically. helps when diagnosing rollbacks. thoughts? kiran: cool idea. keep it passive: scrubber previews only with low-cost queries (no heavy diffs). show a mini-sparkline per version in the scrub preview. maria: data privacy note: the scrubber should not reveal user identifiers in quick previews; keep only aggregates. taylor: implementation: storybook story for timeline with keyboard nav + cluster expand states + confirm modal. i'll build it after copy/a11y are finalized. nina: i'll add a minimal aria snippet checklist to the figma frame: dialog roles, aria-expanded, aria-controls, live regions for rollback progress, focus order notes, and contrast tokens. sam: i'll queue the PR template extras: include 'shortcuts added' and 'destructive flow tested' flags. handoff-bot: timeline-compact-clusters review task created (#4980). due 72h. reminders scheduled. jamie: action items: jamie - update colors + em-dash copy; kiran - consolidate condensed rows + staging/prod CTA rule; nina - paste aria checklist; taylor - storybook scaffold; sam - PR template additions. aiming to handoff early next week. thanks all :sparkles:
